# Ratecard

> Published AI API list prices (USD per 1M tokens), one row per model and provider, each with a source URL and check date. 86 rows, 57 verified, 14 providers. Last checked 2026-10-30.

## Methodology
Prices come only from each provider's own pricing page, docs, or public pricing API. Unverified means we could not read a number on the check date — the cell stays blank. We never invent rates. Details: https://ratecardai.pages.dev/methodology.html

## Data (CC BY 4.0 — please attribute "Ratecard" + link https://ratecardai.pages.dev/)

- [All models (CSV)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/models.csv)
- [Providers (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/providers.json)
- [Change log (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/changes.json)
- [Change log (CSV)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/changes.csv)
- [OpenAPI](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/openapi.json)
- [Full dump](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Dataset summary
- Units: USD per 1M tokens (unless unit/other says otherwise)
- Fields: input, output, cached, batch_input, batch_output, context, long_context, status, source, checked
- Cheapest verified text (in+out): OpenRouter Qwen3.7 Flash (Qwen) ($0.030 / $0.13)
